# Tasks: Automatic Unchanged-Intent Redefinition

Six all-open canonical units implement the revised Feature 015 contract at `.dude/specs/015-automatic-unchanged-intent-redefinition/spec.md`. The work extends the existing `reconcile-derived-definition` action, Feature 009 learning evidence, and `applyDefinitionRecovery` atomic composition. One independent semantic review binds the coordinator-composed exact final four-path bytes and mappings before apply; deterministic identities prove exact identity only. It creates no new action, lane, command, persistent store, ledger, transaction engine, objective system, or quality reduction.

No task carries `[P]`. T001, T002, and T004 share `src/skills/dude-work/recovery.mjs` and its test; T003 and T004 share definition-recovery composition; T005 projects overlapping source prompt changes into `.github/`. The linear dependencies prevent conflicting writes and ensure each semantic layer is proven before the next consumes it.

Durable suffixes are the fixed lowercase hexadecimal encodings of `elig`, `safe`, `atom`, `cont`, `auth`, and `vrfy`.

Every task that edits `src/` runs `node scripts/build-dev.mjs` inside that same unit before parity-sensitive tests. `.github/` is generated only by that command and is never hand-edited. Execution may read but must not write any Feature 009, 013, 014, or 015 definition artifact. A required normative change stops with `contract-mismatch: redefine-required`.
